goal: Review authorization: who can do what, checked on every route, object and action, including access to other u…
use: Review authorization: who can do what, checked on every route, object and action, including access to other users' data. Use when access control or multi-user data is changed.

steps.note: List the actions. List each route, command and background job that reads or changes data.
Check each action has a check. Every action needs an authorization check.
Check object ownership. Flag lookups by ID that do not confirm the caller owns or may see the object (insecure direct object references).
Check roles and defaults. Flag default-allow rules, roles that grant more than they should, and admin checks that are bypassed.
Check the checks. Authorization decided in the client only, or trusted from request fields, is a finding.
Report. List each finding as route and file, with severity, the missing check and the fix.
